meta.description: Common errors and troubleshooting guide for Land Kit

causes: Add Elevation Layer was not run before this component
Environment was not properly initialized with topography mesh
errors.solution: Run 'Add Elevation Layer' component before this operation. It requires a valid topography mesh.
errors.workflow_step: Add Elevation Layer before any terrain-dependent analysis

causes: Calculate CN Layer requires HSG data that hasn't been added
User didn't provide soil group data
errors.solution: Use 'Add Shape Values Layer' component to add HSG data. Pass soil survey boundaries/shapes with HSG values (A, B, C, or D).

causes: Calculate CN Layer requires ground cover data that hasn't been added
User didn't provide land use/cover classification
errors.solution: Use 'Add Shape Values Layer' to add ground cover. Valid values: LAWN, PASTURE, MEADOW, ROW, CONTOURED, WOODS, IMPERVIOUS

causes: Calculate CN Layer requires condition data that hasn't been added
User didn't provide land condition ratings
errors.solution: Use 'Add Shape Values Layer' to add condition data. Valid values: POOR, FAIR, GOOD
errors.default: If not provided, defaults to GOOD

errors.error_message: Invalid HSG value. Expected A, B, C, or D
causes: User provided HSG value outside allowed range
Typo in HSG data (e.g., 'a' instead of 'A')
errors.solution: Ensure HSG values are exactly one of: A, B, C, D (case-insensitive, but will be normalized to uppercase)
errors.note: System automatically converts to uppercase, so lowercase values will work

causes: User provided GC value not in allowed list
Typo in ground cover classification
errors.solution: Use only valid ground cover types from the allowed list. Check spelling carefully.
errors.autocorrect_note: System attempts to coerce names (e.g., GRASSLAND -> PASTURE, RANGE -> PASTURE)

errors.error_message: Shape list length doesn't match value list length
causes: Number of shapes and values don't align
One list is empty when the other isn't
errors.solution: Ensure shapes and values lists have the same length. Each shape needs exactly one corresponding value.

errors.error_message: Area/shape instances and values don't match
causes: When using Area instances, values list might be ignored in favor of area.layer property
errors.solution: If using Area instances, set area.layer property to the desired value. If mixing shapes and values, ensure they match.

errors.error_message: Cell size is too large or too small
causes: Cell size is 0 or negative
Cell size is so small it creates millions of cells (memory issue)
Cell size is larger than the analysis boundary
errors.solution: Use a reasonable cell size between 1 and 1000 feet. Consider your analysis area size and computer memory.
errors.recommendation: For most landscape projects, 5-10 feet is typical

errors.error_message: Boundary curves are invalid or don't enclose area
causes: Boundary curve is not closed
Boundary is self-intersecting
Boundary is not a valid Rhino curve
errors.solution: Ensure boundary curves are valid, closed curves. Join multiple curves if needed. Check that curve geometry is clean.

errors.error_message: Topography mesh is missing or invalid
causes: No mesh was provided to topo input
Mesh is empty or degenerate
errors.solution: Provide a valid topography mesh. Create one in Rhino from DEM data, survey points, or similar.

errors.error_message: CN calculation could not find matching combination
causes: Combination of HSG + GC + Condition doesn't exist in lookup table
One of the three layers is missing
errors.solution: Verify that all three layers (hsg, gc, condition) are present and use valid values.

errors.error_message: CSV file could not be written
causes: File is already open in another program (Excel, etc.)
Path is invalid or not writable
Insufficient disk space
errors.solution: Close the CSV file if open elsewhere. Check file path is valid. Ensure write permissions to directory.

causes: Formula uses non-existent layer names
Python syntax error in formula
Invalid operators or functions
errors.solution: Check formula syntax. Use correct layer names. Verify operations are supported (basic math: +, -, *, /, sqrt, etc.)

causes: Shape is too small relative to cell size
Shape doesn't overlap with environment boundary
Shape is outside the analysis area
errors.solution: Ensure shapes overlap the environment boundary and are larger than cell size. Use smaller cell size if needed.
errors.debugging: Visualize the grid and shapes together to see if they overlap

causes: Cell size too small, creating millions of cells
Analysis area too large
Computer doesn't have enough RAM
errors.solution: Increase cell size, reduce analysis area, or run on a computer with more RAM.
errors.estimate: Each cell uses ~1KB of memory. A 1000-acre site with 5-ft cells = ~50,000 cells = ~50MB minimum

warnings.recommendation: Use the newer alternative component instead

warnings.message: Optional input not provided; using default
warnings.note: Check component documentation for what default value is used

warnings.message: Layer already exists; it will be overwritten
warnings.action: Existing layer data will be replaced with new values

script_not_running: Check that all required inputs are connected
Verify input data types match component requirements
Look for red error indicators on components
Check Rhino console for error messages
unexpected_results: Verify input data is correct (check CAD geometry, layer names)
Ensure proper workflow order (dependencies are met)
Review component descriptions for required data formats
slow_performance: Reduce cell size or analysis area
Run on a more powerful computer for large areas
data_doesnt_match_reality: Verify input data accuracy (soil survey, land use classification)
Confirm topography mesh is correctly georeferenced
Validate cell size is appropriate for study detail level
